description: This file defines the UpdateAdHocCommandHandler class, which handles 'UPDATE' commands for ad-hoc queries within the Fineract platform. It processes incoming JSON commands to update specific ad-hoc queries via a service layer.

classes.name: UpdateAdHocCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles update commands for ad-hoc queries, implementing the logic to process incoming JSON commands and invoke the write platform service to perform updates.

methods.name: UpdateAdHocCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the AdHocWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the processing of the update command, extracting the ad-hoc query ID and delegating the update operation to the write platform service.
